title.name: Title Layouts
title.description: Layouts designed for opening slides, section breaks, and presentations headers.

types.name: Asymmetric Focus
types.description: An offset layout designed for title slides, featuring left-aligned content and a geometric pattern focus card. Best for formal presentations, pitch decks, and corporate portfolios that want to convey a modern, structured, and professional look.

types.name: Split Title
types.description: Split column/row layout designed for title slides. Best for visual-heavy opening slides, portfolio introductions, and keynote presentations where you want to balance bold typography with key introductory info.

types.name: Image Title
types.description: An image-centric layout for title slides, featuring a prominent visual frame, outline borders, and decorative tech SVG corners. Best for highly creative keynote titles, launch presentations, and media decks that require a strong visual header.

bullets.name: Bullet Points
bullets.description: Standard lists or grids containing multiple sequential headers and descriptions.

types.name: Standard List
types.description: A classic vertical list of items, splitting into a 2-column layout when there are more than 4 items. Best for general text outlines, comprehensive summaries, and lists of detailed takeaways that require structured hierarchy without visual clutter.

types.name: Big Bullets
types.description: Bold text bullets with larger typography for emphasizing key points. Best for high-impact key takeaways, core values, or brief statements where each item needs to stand out individually and grab immediate attention.

types.name: Bullets Grid
types.description: A structured grid of bullet items with headers and descriptions. Best for comparisons, product feature breakdowns, or scanning multiple parallel points at a glance without reading sequentially.

types.name: Numbered List
types.description: A vertical list of items with giant index numbers and a primary accent bar. Best for step-by-step guides, procedural instructions, rankings, and linear sequences where the order of items is critical.

cards.name: Card Layouts
cards.description: Grid or block cards to visually separate and present group data.

types.name: Simple Cards
types.description: Clean border-based card grid for showcasing features or items. Best for cataloging product categories, highlighting main service lines, or presenting standard sets of information side-by-side cleanly.

types.name: Left Accent Cards
types.description: Cards with colored left-border accent indicators. Best for highlighting categorizations, priority tasks, or warning details where specific colored border hints draw the eye to individual card states.

types.name: Numbered Cards
types.description: Cards displaying an auto-incrementing index number on the left. Best for illustrating sequential processes, milestone achievements, or prioritized lists that benefit from card structures with clear numeric flow.

types.name: Filled Cards
types.description: Cards styled with a light alternative theme background. Best for emphasizing featured articles, premium plans, or a group of related high-priority highlights that need to pop out from the slide base theme.

stats.name: Key Metrics & Statistics
stats.description: Large text indicators highlighting critical figures or metrics.

types.name: Stats Grid
types.description: Grid display of big numbers and their descriptions. Automatically switches layout configurations depending on item count. Best for dashboard summaries, quarterly reports, and showing multiple performance KPIs at once.

types.name: Stats Row
types.description: A single row/column layout displaying statistics side-by-side or stacked. Best for comparative growth rates, side-by-side year-over-year metrics, or short sequential statistics.

types.name: Large Stat Callout
types.description: Emphasizes a single massive key metric with a detailed text callout description. Best for highlighting a single monumental breakthrough metric, such as total sales revenue, user milestones, or key survey percentages.

timelines.name: Timelines
timelines.description: Display events, steps, or progression sequences chronologically.

types.name: Horizontal Curved Timeline
types.description: Steps placed horizontally on a curve line, scaling from 2 to 6 items. Best for detailing chronological project roadmaps, historical progression steps, and multi-phase release plans stretching from left to right.

types.name: Vertical Timeline
types.description: A layout displaying chronological steps connected along a vertical timeline line with circle nodes. Best for mobile-friendly presentations, scrolling timelines, meeting agendas, and historical company histories containing vertical flow.

types.name: Alternating Timeline
types.description: Steps arranged in an alternating left-to-right zigzag fashion along a central axis. Best for dynamic storytelling, company histories, and product evolution narratives where you want to split content visually to make it highly engaging.

constraints.other: Odd number of points is preferred for horizontal curved timeline.

icons.name: Icon Layouts
icons.description: Visual layouts featuring prominent icons to represent concepts.

types.name: Icons Grid
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features, key service pillars, or high-level business capabilities using thematic visual metaphors.

types.name: Icons Row
types.description: A horizontal row of items with icons centered above the text. Best for displaying team roles, sequential steps, or parallel feature lists where a clean, symmetric row layout with icon indicators is desired.

types.name: Icons List
types.description: A vertical list of items with icons aligned to the left of the text. Best for feature lists with long descriptions, resource links, or agendas where the icons act as clear bullet-point markers.

constraints.other: iconKeywords field is an array each of its elements are single keyword string for icon search or generation (3 - 4) keywords

images.name: Image Layouts
images.description: Visual layouts incorporating prominent images as central elements.

types.name: Image Split
types.description: A customizable 50/50 split section layout with toggleable left/right image alignment and multiple listing styles (Cards, Plain, Accent, Bullet, Numbered). Best for product spotlight slides, company story introductions, or matching an illustrative image with a list of points.

types.name: Image Grid
types.description: A grid of cards where each item features its own image. Best for team bio slides, product gallery showcasing, case study grids, or visual portfolios where every item requires its own visual representation.

constraints.other: imageDescription field is a string for image search or generation, keep it concise (less than 150 chars)

closing.name: Closing Slides
closing.description: Layouts designed for closing presentations, including Q&A, Contact, Call-to-Action, and Thank You slides.

types.name: Thank You
types.description: A classic outro slide layout saying thank you with presenter details. Best for concluding any formal slide deck, leaving a polite thank you note, and displaying the presenter's signature or credentials.

types.name: Q&A Outro
types.description: A clean layout with visual focus on 'Questions?' or Q&A session. Best for ending presentations on an interactive note, inviting the audience to speak, and keeping the screen focused during open discussion.

types.name: Contact Info
types.description: Displays social handles, emails, and phone numbers in a structured layout. Best for sales pitches, portfolio decks, and networking sessions where the primary goal is to share contact details and social media channels.
